column1: # TVI-WO-1202a: each case's and mutant's wall time in seconds, the weight tools/tviburi-route plan packs shards by.
# Re-weighed by TVI-WO-1204 (6) from main's CI run 45804127687 (the push of d6e88c9, #61's merge: 988 items, ten shard jobs,
# four CPU models) with 1202a's method: an item's time is the gap from the previous item's last line to its own. Each shard's
# speed is its median item against the previous weights, over the run's seven Intel Xeon 6975P-C shards (0.97-1.01; the EPYC
# 7763 shard ran at 1.47, the EPYC 9V74 at 1.10, the EPYC 9V45 at 0.81); an item weighs its time divided by its shard's speed.
# So every weight is at the 6975P-C's speed (1.00). Items that run did not have are estimated: teardown (250) and its mutant
# TD01-endFlush (260) from Furnace runs; guards, witnessed; the rest at their kind's median. Checked against TVI-WO-1204's
# own CI in its FEEDBACK. The previous weights are in this file's git history.
# Never the list of what runs: that is the tree's own (tests/spike.sh, tests/mutants.tsv); an item missing here
# weighs its kind's median and still runs. KIND<tab>ID<tab>SECONDS.
